policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Caldo de cebolla caramelizada a fuego lento, cubierto con pan rústico tostado y abundante queso Gruyère fundido.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-simmered caramelized onion broth topped with toasted rustic bread and melted Gruyère cheese.

products.nameEs: Ensalada de Queso de Cabra Tibio
products.descriptionEs: Medallón de queso de cabra empanizado sobre lechugas mixtas frescas, nueces caramelizadas y vinagreta de frambuesa.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy panko-crusted warm goat cheese medallion over mixed greens, candied walnuts, and house raspberry vinaigrette.

products.descriptionEs: Finísimas láminas de filete de res con alcaparras, albahaca fresca, aceite de oliva virgen extra y virutas de Parmesano.
products.descriptionEn: Thinly sliced raw beef tenderloin served with capers, fresh basil, extra virgin olive oil, and shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano.

products.nameEs: Salmón a la Plancha con Salsa de Limón y Hierbas
products.nameEn: Pan-Seared Salmon with Herb Lemon Sauce
products.descriptionEn: Fresh pan-seared salmon fillet served with truffle mashed potatoes and garlic-sauteed asparagus.
Braised organic chicken breast with cherry tomatoes, Kalamata olives, capers, garlic, and white wine reduction.
Creamy Arborio rice simmered with assorted wild mushrooms, white truffle oil, and aged parmesan cheese.

products.nameEn: Filet Mignon with Red Wine Reduction
products.descriptionEn: 8 oz prime center-cut grilled filet mignon in a rich Bordeaux reduction, served with potato gratin.

products.nameEs: Costillitas de Cordero en Costra de Hierbas
products.descriptionEn: Tender rack of lamb with a provencal herb crust, garlic mashed potatoes, and seasonal vegetables.

products.nameEs: Magret de Pato con Salsa de Naranja
products.descriptionEn: Juicy duck breast with crisp skin, served with a classic sweet and tangy orange Grand Marnier glaze.
Freshly squeezed lemonade infused with artisanal wild lavender syrup and a sprig of fresh mint.
Rich Italian-roast espresso with an intense body and a velvety crema layer.
Natural sparkling mineral water bottled at the source in the Italian Alps.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, pregunte a nuestro personal por las opciones marcadas en el menú o adaptadas para sus necesidades dietéticas.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please ask our staff for items marked on the menu or tailored to your dietary needs.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono o en línea.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone or online reservations.
